Leterrier2024.author: Gauthier Leterrier
Leterrier2024.title: Some Mordell-Weil lattices and applications to sphere packings
locators: Remark 4.1.11, table p.204: lower guarantees in 68D and 74D
findings: Correction: the printed 55D lamination has a norm6 period vector and does not establish its minimum10 or its reported density. A repaired period gives center density90459.838739..., and our cross-coset tilted variant gives91333.867143...; no SOTA claim.
The table reports log2(delta)>=23.14 in 68D and >=25.1586 in 74D; these are below our constructions and below the stronger comparisons already used.

Vardy1999.title: Density doubling, double-circulants, and new sphere packings
Vardy1999.locator: Section 4, p.278, Elkies section guarantees for 57D-63D
Vardy1999.finding: 60D-62D improvements checked against the UPPER end of each reported decimal-prefix interval, not merely a rational floor.

Chen2013.title: On a generalization of Craig lattices
Chen2013.finding: The published 68D values are around log2(delta)=20.5; both conflicting displayed values are below the classical Gamma72 section comparison, log2(delta)=29.

WenChangWeng2019.title: Improved Upper Bounds on the Hermite and KZ Constants
WenChangWeng2019.finding: Linear bounds do not improve the Blichfeldt bound in the dimensions at issue; they add no competing stronger section input.

Rogers1958.title: The packing of equal spheres
Rogers1958.finding: The exact classical simplex bound is stronger than our conservative second-moment enclosure. The 53D and 89D-91D controls are numerical evaluations of inherited section theory, not new-record construction claims.

Nebe2012.title: An even unimodular 72-dimensional lattice of minimum 8
Nebe2012.role: Gamma72 parent, explicit Leech block and derived section controls in 65D-71D; product controls in 73D-76D

SchuttShioda2017.title: Mordell-Weil Lattices, author draft 16 March 2017
SchuttShioda2017.role: MW56, MW80 and MW92 guarantees; derived products in 57D, 82D-83D, 93D-95D
